thread:
jess: FYI customer reported SSO failures right after IdP rotated keys earlier today. intermittent 403s, some users can log in after retry, others cannot. ticket INC-8421 opened.

omar (Acme): yes, hit this around 10:12 PST. some users get redirected back with 'InvalidSignature' on our side. other users succeed. nothing changed on our end.

morgan: can you paste the SAMLResponse error from the logs and the IdP metadata URL? also which cert type did they rotate (rsa/ecdsa)?

jess: logs attached from our sso-service: ```
ERROR sso-verify - InvalidSignature: signature verification failed (algorithm ECDSA)
Context: tenant=acme, request_id=8f3b, user=j.smith@example.com
```
IdP metadata: https://idp.acme.example/.well-known/saml/metadata.xml
They rotated to ECDSA (per Acme).

triage-bot: New incident INC-8421 created and linked to this thread. Priority: P2. Assigned to support oncall.

morgan: pulled metadata.xml from that URL and ran our parser against it — seeing two KeyDescriptor blocks. first one has no use attribute, second one is `use="signing"`. the IdP's signed assertions are using ECDSA but signedkey isn't first. our parser currently picks the first KeyDescriptor as the default signing key when use is omitted. that will fail if the first is actually an encryption-only key. snippet: ```xml
<KeyDescriptor>
  <KeyInfo>... (ECDH-encryption-key) ...</KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
<KeyDescriptor use="signing">
  <KeyInfo>... (ECDSA-signing-key) ...</KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
```

jess: interesting — that would explain why only some assertions fail (depends on which key the IdP referenced?). customer says they didn't change metadata order, only rotated certs. could CDN/cache be serving old metadata occasionally?

morgan: yes — fetching metadata directly vs via our metadata-cache-proxy returned different ordering earlier. CDN cache-control headers were missing so old file lingered at edge. our poller then picked the cached copy and used wrong key. repro steps I ran: 1) curl metadata URL via edge -> got older XML (encryption key first) 2) curl origin -> got updated XML (signing key marked). parsing the edge copy reproduces InvalidSignature.

lara: can infra purge the metadata CDN for that path? need to ensure all regions fetch updated metadata. tagging @nate oncall.

nate: purged CDN edge for /saml/metadata.xml across us-west/us-east/eu. confirmed origin now served to edges. also bumped metadata poller to force-refresh for tenant=acme. :white_check_mark:

omar (Acme): testing now... user who failed earlier can log in successfully. will test with a handful more.

omar (Acme): quick update — 8/8 test users succeeded after purge. looks fixed. thanks. :tada:

morgan: short-term workaround for customers hitting this: advise them to flush their IdP metadata distribution (if they control a CDN) or add explicit `<KeyDescriptor use="signing">` to their metadata. long-term fix: I'll open a PR to make our metadata parser prefer explicit `use="signing"` keys and fall back to searching for `<KeyDescriptor use="signing">` before taking the first key when use is omitted. also add extra validation/logging when algorithm types mismatch (rsa vs ecdsa).

jess: please link the PR and include a migration note for metadata poller behavior. also let's update the runbook to check CDN cache and cache-control headers as a triage step.

morgan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sso-service/pull/512 — implements prefer-signing-key logic + forced-refresh endpoint for poller. scheduled for canary tomorrow.

lara: adding runbook step now: "If customer rotated certs and you see intermittent InvalidSignature, check metadata ordering and CDN cache. Purge edges, force poller refresh."

nate: monitoring in place for INC-8421. will watch auth failure rate for tenant=acme for next 6h.

jess: closing loop with customer, marking incident resolved pending 6h of monitoring. follow-ups: runbook + PR review + small infra doc about metadata cache-control defaults. :heavy_check_mark:
